content: Un'sak akà mbuur ataŋà un'kaan wà!
Un'kaan wà we anà imɛɛy kàwɛl Yɛsu Klistɔ. Nzam kya kun'pɛ ntɔn nde uswɛŋ akà asyääl ande ndaa ayà iyà benàben. Yɛsu ya kàkyään akà un'syääl ande Ywan u mbwo a un'kyeey ande.
Ywan wà mbäl a indiir byanswà kàmɛn nde: Ndaa a Nzam anà imbäl a Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Un'sak akà mbuur akataŋà anà akà baar bàweemà ndaa a ngɔɔm ban'sɔn uboo kwo anà bàfàkaar ya. Ntɔn taaŋ là tsütsü mukwo.
Mbɔr akà Ikööŋ nsambwaar
Ywan akà Ikööŋ nsambwaar abyà kà Azi: Kab a ngway anà duu màkäl anà bɛ. Ma man'fà akà mbuur kàkäl, awà paa anà uyà, anà akà an'dweelà nsambwaar amà kusà a kir a imwol,
anà akà Yɛsu Klistɔ, mbäl afàkölà ndaa yanswà, nswɛm uboo a akü, mwol a amfum a mɛɛn. Akà mbuur afikwen, nde kitwey uboo a man'be abi u mbwo a an'kil ande,
nde kibuul itsuŋ a angaŋ ntɔn musyääl Taarànde Nzam. Wɛy làkoo anà ngwal ikäl anà nde u mbul a in'tye! Yà abwɛy.
Le, nde wàmuyà uboo a un'böŋ. Baar banswà bàkyer asun'man, itàkal baar akwà bun'pfuul: in'sɛŋ myanswà myà mɛɛn isàsà un'saabà ntɔn nde. Inye, yà abwɛy.
Mwol, Nzam Aŋangwal, kan'tɛn naa: « Mɛ in'wà wàtàtwɛb anà wàntsüü, mbuur awà paa, awà kàkäl anà uyà. »
Ywan anà imanmii a Yɛsu
Mɛ un'tɔŋ abɛ Ywan, mbuur kàtüüb mbwo anà bɛ unsà ngyɛb, unsà imfum anà muküünà amu Yɛsu. Mɛ kàkäl kà isaŋ a Patmɔs ntɔn Ndaa a Nzam anà imbäl a Yɛsu.
Ilä a Mwol, Dweelà làkyer an'wal, mɛ kàwem ndaa a ngwal ungö a mɛ asànaa mfuŋ,

yàmutɛn naa: « Undiir wanswà amanà ngye, sɔn wa uboo a un'kaan anà tɔm wa akà Ikööŋ nsambwaar: akà Ɛfɛsɔ, akà Smirne, akà Pɛrgam, akà Tyatir, akà Sardɛs, akà Filadɛlfi anà akà Lawɔdisɛ. »
Mɛ kàkyer abulà ntɔn muyöb mbuur awà kàyäämà anà mɛ. Apan mɛ kàmɛn in'te a minà nsambwaar myà wɔl.
Uboboo a mya kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy asànaa mwan a mbuur, akyàbwaar mvwɛl anà un'kab a wɔl aŋàbäm kà itɔl.
Un'tswe anà ntswe ande yàkäl yà pɛɛl asànaa ipfɛy a pɛɛl, asànaa mbul a pɛɛl. Mii ande myàkäl asànaa làlem a mbaa,
in'kɔl ande asànaa ishabà bàfàbel naa brɔnze aŋàyir a mbaa, ndaa ande asànaa làso a iwɔɔl.
U kɔɔ ande là ibaal, nde kàkäl anà mbwaar, mbwaar nsambwaar. Kɔm àŋàsye làyatoo u mun ande. Mun ande kàkäl asànaa taaŋ là paa in'ŋyäŋ u ngwal ande yanswà.
Mpal kun'mɛn mɛ, mɛ kàbü kà in'kɔl ande asànaa mbuur aŋàkwà. Nde kàsi kɔɔ ande là ibaal udu a mɛ, anà mutɛn naa: « Twon an'man bɔɔmà! Mɛ in'wà mbuur atàtwɛb anà wàntsüü,
anà wà Mɔ̈ɔ̈. Mɛ kàkyer akwà, wɛɛ le, mɛ in'we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Nsab a ukwà anà an'lɔŋ yà u kɔɔ amɛ.
Abun, sɔn indiir byanswà an'man ngye anà indiir isàyà ungö a bya.
Ngyee a mbwaar nsambwaar amɛn ngye u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal anà in'te a minà nsambwaar myà wɔl ayi: mbwaar nsambwaar yà akyeey a Ikööŋ nsambwaar, in'te a minà nsambwaar myà Ikööŋ nsambwaar. »
